overview.summary: The Ruined City of Dranik was once the cultural and military heart of the Dranik people before the Muramite invasion shattered it.

timeline.name: Founding of Dranik
timeline.description: Dranik rises as a fortified capital, blending martial discipline with planar warding.

timeline.name: First Discord Rifts
timeline.description: Discord anomalies appear near the city, prompting defensive research.

timeline.name: Siege of Dranik
timeline.description: Muramite forces breach the city after prolonged siege, collapsing major districts.

timeline.name: Collapse of the Citadel
timeline.description: The central citadel falls, triggering temporal fractures and massive Discord bleed.

timeline.name: Current Era
timeline.description: Survivors hide among ruins while Riftseekers attempt to stabilize planar damage.

key_events.name: Citadel Break
key_events.description: The citadel’s collapse created the largest temporal fracture in Kuua.

key_events.name: Rift Anchor Establishment
key_events.description: Riftseekers establish an arcane anchor to prevent total planar collapse.
